solver.title: Automatic scheduling
solver.intro: The solver places as many lessons as possible without breaking a hard rule, then improves gaps, shifts and buildings. The result is saved as a new draft — the published timetable does not change.

modeHint.rebuild: Lessons in the chosen scope are placed again. Pinned lessons and lessons outside the scope stay where they are.
modeHint.fill: All existing lessons stay; only lessons not yet placed are added.

solver.weightsHint: The higher the weight, the harder the solver avoids it. 0 means ignored.
